capabilities: Run AI actions on selected text from a context menu or the Action Palette
Insert or replace text with model answers, including image-capable models
Ground answers in note context from links, backlinks, and PDF files via RAG
Create custom actions with per-action prompt, system prompt, creativity, and reasoning settings
Browse, install, and auto-update community actions from settings
disambiguation: Not limited to GPT models; it works with any Ollama or OpenAI-like provider configured through the AI Providers plugin.
extras: Local model setup requires installing embedding models via Ollama (nomic-embed-text or bge-m3); the README notes no speed benefit on the author's MacBook Pro M1 16GB and promises no response-time improvement. Also installable via BRAT (pfrankov/obsidian-local-gpt).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance, and cloud AI assistants conflict with the privacy and offline use that a local vault implies.

relations.evidence: You also need to install the AI Providers plugin from the plugin store to configure AI providers

summary: AI assistant plugin that runs Ollama and OpenAI-like models locally to act on selected text via a context menu and an Action Palette.
